mechanical_handoff.branches: Same parent, forcing, exterior conditions and finite source accounts; coupled versus proposed replacement
mechanical_handoff.support: Predeclared physical A with common material correspondence, complete motion components and the same permitted rigid-frame projection
mechanical_handoff.window: [t0,t0+H], H>0 supplied before execution and within source/event validity; revalidate on expiry
mechanical_handoff.norm: Spatial maximum Euclidean velocity error, supremum over entire window
mechanical_handoff.reference: V_ref is supremum of replacement speed on same support, window and gauge; zero or unproved reference refuses relative certification
mechanical_handoff.integrated_velocity_error_bound_m: eps_v*V_ref*H; not automatically a particle trajectory bound
mechanical_handoff.work_energy: Independently preserve external work, dissipation, stored elastic energy and heat accounts; no energy bound inferred from velocity alone
